module: Flowgraph node "Set Recovery Prompt Limits" (category once_instant). Limits the number of uses of each recovery prompt button (-1 = unlimited); with no use remaining the button is no longer selectable. Number input pins: flipMission (5), recoverMission (5), submitMission (-1), restartMission (-1); custom number pins are allowed and saved. Depends on gameplay_walk.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the flowgraph editor (ImGui).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

workOnce.desc: Builds the limits table from the non-nil number pins, calls core_recoveryPrompt.setButtonLimits(limits) then resetButtonLimitCounters(counts) to reset the counters to zero.
